notice: Platform A and Platform B are local resource-budget emulations on the same host, not official physical target-platform measurements. Replace or supplement them with organizer measurements if provided.

profiles.name: Platform A - resource-rich baseline (local host)
profiles.note: Scans every supported file in the selected tree on the current machine; single process, no hardware acceleration.

profiles.name: Platform B - constrained service budget (emulated)
profiles.note: Caps each file at 64 KiB and total selected files at 50; emulates a scan budget, not a physical single-core/RAM-limited machine.

profiles.name: Platform D - custom memory-constrained migration scanner
profiles.note: Custom stress-test profile: scans at most 20 supported files and 16 KiB per file. This creates a constrained scanning budget to study coverage and runtime trade-offs; it is an emulation on the current host, not a separate physical platform.
